title: Chapter 566 - 566 Doomsday; Countdown! (1)
content:
Chapter 566 - 566 Doomsday; Countdown! (1)

Chapter 566 - 566 Doomsday; Countdown! (1)

566 Doomsday; Countdown! (1)

[Doomsday mission: The universe is fair. Every world has its initial birth, development, and final destruction. However, after the Earth started suffering from the wanton destruction of mankind, the day of its final destruction was brought forward!

[However, the universe is willing to give you a chance to save Earth!

[After completing the mission, you’ll receive a large amount of rewards…]

Doomsday mission?

Earth was going to be destroyed?

Even though Lin Fan had a pretty good ability to accept things, he was stunned by this mission on the spot. He did not move for a long time.

…

It was also at this moment…

Everywhere in the world, whether it was a private bedroom, a large flat, a plane without signal, or a dark basement… an emotionless voice sounded.

“Countdown to the end of the world.

“Next, a Void Gate will randomly appear in the territories of 200 countries around the world. A certain number of human representatives from each country will be randomly selected to enter the Otherworld.

“The live broadcast of the human representatives’ activities in the Otherworld will be shown at the various Void Gates.

“At the same time, the Void Gates will spew out a terrifying fog of destruction or a magical light of life based on the performance of the human representatives from various countries.

“Void Gates, appear!

“Choose your representatives!

“Three days later, the representatives will enter the Otherworld!”

“Doomsday is here!”

The voice stopped.

It was also at this moment that in the sky above the bustling city, in the empty fields, and in the desolate mountains… a huge black door appeared.

In the middle of the black door, the starlight formed a huge countdown that read ’71:59:59.’

When the voice appeared, many people thought that they had forgotten to turn the speakers off.

However, when they saw the Void Gate, everyone’s mouths and eyes were wide open. They were completely stunned.

Some people hurriedly took out their phones to take a photo.

Some screamed loudly.

Others instantly cried.

The chaos had officially begun!

Weibo, Facebook, BBS, and the rest of the internet…

The top ten trending searches on all social media platforms had become the topic of doomsday in just five minutes.

Times Have Changed: [Doomsday! Is this true?]

Firmament: [That Void Gate is too terrifying.]

Waning Moon: [Countdown, countdown… In 72 hours, Earth will be destroyed!]

Useless Scholar: [What should we do now? I don’t want to die yet.]

Ruthless Time: [Why, why is it suddenly doomsday?]

Moon on the Tree: [Hasn’t the energy problem been solved?]

Guardian: [Please tell me that this is not true. This is a joke the country is playing on us, right? This must be some high-tech product invented by the country, a three-dimensional projection, right? Professor Lin! Yes, this must be the 3D projection technology invented by Professor Lin!]

Magic Attack: [Professor Lin, please step out and answer.]

Stone: [Alright, don’t call out to Professor Lin anymore. Now, the one who’s suffering the most… is probably him. It’s better not to disturb him. Professor Lin has invented many high-tech products, so he’s definitely a staunch atheist.

[In the end, such a situation occurred. Perhaps there really is a god in this world.

[This could be said to have shattered Professor Lin’s worldview!]

Ordinary People Far: [This is indeed not a 3D projection technology. As far as I know, just as the voice said, Void Gates have appeared in all countries in the world.

[If it was a three-dimensional projection technology, how big would the projector be?

[This kind of projector would definitely be easily discovered.

[However, so far, there’s no news of the projector. In fact, there’s no light source.

[The Void Gates are real!

[In addition, the voice from before sounded at the same time. This isn’t something that a projector can do. In fact, it can’t be done with any high-tech equipment!]

Half-Human Half-Beast: [So we’re done for? Is the apocalypse really coming?]

Mr. Zhang: [Didn’t they say that each country will randomly select some representatives? As long as the representatives perform well, the world won’t be destroyed.]

Disheartened: [Nashland has just sent news that a football player has been selected as a representative!]

Uncle Wang: [There’s news from Japes that a streetcar driver will become a representative.]

Love You Forever: [Say, an investigator from Eagle Country has become a representative.]

…

Heart Like Still Water: [So many countries’ representatives have been announced. What about ours? Who’s chosen from our country?]

Huhuhu: [Yeah, where’s our country’s representative? I heard that the representatives of the other countries have all been arranged for emergency training and equipment selection… Our country has to hurry up too.]

…

In fact, it was not just the netizens who were discussing and panicking. The higher-ups of Hua Nation were holding an emergency meeting. They had a heated discussion.

“How many Void Gates have appeared in our country?”

“A total of 30!”

“What do you think of this doomsday declaration?”

“This is not an effect that can be produced by any currently known technology. That’s because the Void Gates can be found all over the world.”

“In the vast universe, there might really be some unknown entity.”

At this point, the atmosphere at the scene could not help but become gloomy.

It felt like they had suddenly become weak ants. They were extremely helpless.
